description:
Cast Priest of Gix.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Healer of the Pride triggers, gaining you 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix to add {C}{C}.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1}{B} and 2 life to return Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
